Your holdings: Your leveraged positions, SOXL (-48.11%) and SPAL (-62.31%), are in deep drawdowns and flagged for attention. SMH (-10.48%) also needs a close eye on its stop. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close watch on overall market volatility and any shifts in retail sentiment. Crucially, monitor your stops on SOXL and SMH, as they are critical risk management levels.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your significant drawdowns and leveraged exposure; the current market environment demands vigilance.
